reason: Call-neighbor diversity fixes the original callee crowding and improves pressure scores, but prioritizes an irrelevant callee tracing note over a useful direct wire-format note in a fresh countercase. Structural association alone cannot decide note relevance.

plan.candidate: Resolve explicit symbols and their immediate call neighbors using the existing graph. Rank one memory per focused symbol per round, direct symbols before neighbors within a round; other linked symbols follow in original order. Do not exclude candidates or change limits/defaults.
acceptance: No relevant memory retrieved by either original or exact-priority is lost.
Recover the pressure-case callee and improve pressure precision over exact-priority.
Off/counted memory results and fallback order unchanged.
Fresh countercases retain direct contracts and cross-file/two-hop rationales.

next_experiment.architectural_evidence: query.rs runs local reranking around lines 1509-1590, before symbol_links::lift around lines 1744-1764. The lifted candidates get no subsequent semantic scoring.
next_experiment.distinction_from_prior_failed_trial: The earlier query-ranking trial used the existing lexical retrieval arms with no semantic model. This proposal requires an explicit local reranker profile and local-inference build; it has not been measured in these zero-model-call fixtures.
